recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. It completes a missed active source location for FHIR-35987 without changing unrelated publisher search-parameter descriptions or reopening later unresolved author/publisher clarification work.
issue_request: FHIR-35987 was Published/Persuasive with Modification and asked to clarify that publisher is a synonym for steward by changing publisher element short names to publisher/steward and definitions to responsibility for release and ongoing maintenance.

additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps CanonicalResource and MetadataResource active and maps MetadataResource.publisher to CanonicalResource.publisher. It also keeps the Shareable logical model active, and that spreadsheet source still carried older proposal wording. Terminology and FHIR-I minutes support replacing valueset-steward with the standard publisher/steward concept. FHIR-29944 is already represented on the combined branch as older superseded background; FHIR-51205 is later Resolved - change required context outside this default applied/published decision scope.
reconciliation: Updated source/shareable/shareable-spreadsheet.xml so Shareable.publisher now uses "Name of the publisher/steward (organization or individual)" and the release/ongoing-maintenance definition matching the current CanonicalResource wording.
source_changes: source/shareable/shareable-spreadsheet.xml: changed Shareable.publisher short name and definition from older publisher (or steward)/published (or stewards) wording to the approved publisher/steward release-and-maintenance wording.
